## 2300 - 2357

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02300">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2300 QFV - Quality frozen value</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02300">

Quality Frozen Value exceptions are related to the limits that are defined in the Quality Source Validations for both Gas and Liquid Sources. If a Source continues to report the same value for a particular data point over a number of consecutive samples, it is possible the reading is inaccurate and the results are caused by a frozen value that is not being updated. Quality Frozen Value validations allow the user to specify whether to look for frozen values, the number of records for which each value must persist before it is considered frozen, and the limit for each value, which serves as a tolerance level within which values will be treated as identical.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02301">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2301 QFV - Frozen relative density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02301">

FLOWCAL will compare the current sample’s Relative Density to the Relative Density value on a specified number of prior samples. If the value on the specified samples does not change by more than the user-defined limit, then an exception will be generated.

For example, if the Frozen Value comparison window is set to 3 records and Relative Density is set to a difference of 0.001. The following samples will cause this exception to be generated on Sample A.

Sample A (08/01/2016): Relative Density = 0.5925

Sample B (07/01/2016): Relative Density = 0.5926

Sample C (01/01/2016): Relative Density = 0.5926

</div>
